item.title: K-INDSCAL package for R?
item.description:
Originally posted on r/AskStatistics but was recommended to post here...
I want to use a type of multidimensional scaling (MDS) called K-INDSCAL (basically K means clustering and individual differences scaling combined) but I can't find a pre-existing R package and I can't figure out how people did it in the papers written about it. [The original paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27519687/) has lots of formulas and examples, but no source code or anything.
Has anyone worked with this before and/or can point me in the right direction for how to run this in R? Thanks so much!
